passive.name: Martial Cadence
passive.description: Jarvan's first basic attack on an enemy deals bonus physical damage based on their current Health. This effect cannot occur again on the same enemy for a few seconds.

spells.name: Dragon Strike
spells.description: Jarvan extends his lance, dealing physical damage and removing % Armor for seconds. If the lance connects with Demacian Standard, Jarvan will pull himself to it, Knocking Up those in his path for 0.75 seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Golden Aegis
spells.description: Jarvan summons an aegis, Slowing nearby enemies by % for seconds and granting him a Shield, increased by for each enemy champion hit.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Demacian Standard
spells.description: Passive: Jarvan gains % Attack Speed. Active: Jarvan throws a standard into the ground, dealing magic damage and granting allies near the standard % Attack Speed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Cataclysm
spells.description: Jarvan heroically leaps to an enemy Champion, dealing physical damage to them and surrounding enemies and creating an arena of impassable terrain around them for seconds. Jarvan can Recast to collapse the terrain.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamageCalc was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
